definitions.explanation: A formal talk given to an audience.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}でスピーチをした。
examples.english: I gave a speech at the wedding.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}のスピーチを{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I listened to the president's speech.

examples.japanese: スピーチの{練習|れんしゅう}をしている。

notes:
スピーチ comes from English 'speech' and refers to formal speeches delivered to audiences.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- スピーチをする (give a speech)
- スピーチを{頼|たの}まれる (be asked to give a speech)
- スピーチ{原稿|げんこう} (speech manuscript)

COMMON OCCASIONS:
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}のスピーチ (wedding speech)
- {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}スピーチ (graduation speech)
- {祝辞|しゅくじ} (congratulatory speech)

SPEECH TYPES:
- {乾杯|かんぱい}のスピーチ (toast speech)
- {送別|そうべつ}スピーチ (farewell speech)
- {就任|しゅうにん}スピーチ (inaugural speech)

RELATED WORDS:
- {演説|えんぜつ} (speech, address - more formal/political)
- {挨拶|あいさつ} (greeting, address)
- プレゼンテーション (presentation)
- {講演|こうえん} (lecture)
